title: Resolution honoring Alvin Ailey's life and dance legacy
summary: This Council resolution recognizes the life and legacy of Alvin Ailey, founder of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater in New York City in 1958, and honors his contributions to American dance. It highlights his creation of The Ailey School in 1969 and Ailey II in 1974, and notes the company now performs in more than seventy countries and reaches thousands of youth through education programs.
